Tillu being serious for 30 seconds

Dear Inshu,

We've known each other since 5th standard, and we've been properly friends since 8th. That's a ridiculous amount of time to collect memories, jokes, random conversations and embarrassing stories.

But if I had to choose one thing I'm most grateful for, it's the trust. You're one of those people with whom I don't have to pretend or overthink everything.

I hope this next year brings you happiness that feels peaceful, people who genuinely value you, and moments that make you smile for no reason.

And yes, I fully expect us to create many more stories that should probably never be told in public. 😂

Happy birthday, Inshu. Stay exactly this cute, funny, adorable human.

— Your Tillu ♡
